correctness.rationale: Partition reductions mod p into no roots, one simple linear root, two simple quadratic roots, one singular quadratic root, and zero polynomial. For a singular reduction the value at a lift is constant in residue lift; one affine equation gives p² successful out of p³ coefficient lifts, each contributing p roots. For zero reduction g=p h, each root mod p gives p lifts; exclude only the all-zero triple from p^6 total. This yields the five coefficients A0,A1,A2,Ap,A2p and colliding exponents for p=2. Double-point evaluation yields E R²=(3p⁶−2p⁵−p⁴)/(p⁶−1); singular mass Ap∼p⁴ explains E R^k∼p^(k−2). Independent complete tiny-prime enumeration p=2,3,5 agreed; analytic classification covers every prime.
